title: Hamlet
author: William Shakespeare
license: CC BY-NC 3.0 Unported (Folger Shakespeare, Folger Shakespeare Library); internal testing only
description: The production failure. Folger Shakespeare PDF (Chrome/Skia print, 144 letter pages): ~8 pages of front matter (contents, director's note, textual introduction, synopsis, Characters in the Play); every line prefixed 'FTLN 0001'; through-line numbers every 5 lines at the right margin; running header 'page Hamlet ACT 1. SC. 1'; speaker names in caps, inline ('BARNARDO Who's there?') for single-line speeches and on their own line above verse; delivery directions after the cue ('POLONIUS, aside'); editorial brackets drawn as images (missing from the text layer); the text layer lists FTLN numbers and cues out of reading order unless sorted by position.
goldenMethod: folger_tei.py on the same edition's TEI (Ham.xml, v0.9.2.2, from hamlet_XML_FolgerShakespeare.zip). One speech per <sp>; text = w/c/pc tokens with <stage>, <app>/<rdg>, <fw>, <pb> removed; <q> gets curly quotes as Folger's stylesheet renders them; cue = <speaker> text as printed. One speaker-less <sp> (a crowd noise quoted inside a direction, 4.5.176) is not a speech. stageDirectionCount = <stage> elements in <body>. Checked with verify.py (1136/1137 speeches found >=95% verbatim in the PDF text layer, cue found before 1135) and by hand: first 30, last 10, 20 random, characters, sections.
